rubric.time_scope: stated conditions and applicability must agree; dated append reports may coexist without pretending both current; no invented onset from a reporting clock
rubric.source_meaning: speaker, support and expressed modality must remain faithful; label observed under actual user ownership/unchecked verification alone is not proof of independent observation or automatic failure

rubric.qa: first official labels unchanged; all answers/missing reviewed for source fidelity separately; no selective rescoring
rubric.source_only_state: N/A, original storage/visibility and QA reviewed; no invented semantic state
rubric.append_state: evaluate chronology and complete retained facts, not demand in-place replacement
rubric.stratum: maps second event is preservation/preparation; separate from23changes per semantic arm
rubric.state_boundary: Current maintained semantic state (including append dated reports and explicit operative links), not arbitrary reconstruction from raw Sources or unlinked old versions; history remains a separate audit/read capability.
rubric.uncertainty: Ambiguous semantic attribution/date interpretations are explicitly None, not forced passes/failures. Report confirmed UJS and possible-UJS bounds; no unsupported point estimate from ambiguity.
rubric.modality_report_sensitivity: For non-adopted proposals, accepted policy may already be correct without an edit. Strict new-report coverage and accepted-policy target/UJS are both recorded; do not interpret a coverage miss as an incorrect accepted arrangement.
rubric.qa_core: All requested factual parts and their scope must be answered. An explicit refusal to determine the requested current state fails even if correct names appear as historical facts. Extra uncertainty about unspecified later changes is a separate fidelity issue when the requested relative event result is still answered.
